alias.barcodesHint: Extra barcodes that resolve to this same SKU/price — e.g. the same product repackaged by another supplier with its own EAN, or a case/box barcode (units/scan > 1 books that many units at once).
alias.currencyHint: Set an exact price for a channel running in another currency, instead of the auto-converted rate.
alias.scaleHint: For a second (or third) physical scale programmed with its own code for this same product.
alias.scaleLoadFailed: Failed to load additional scale codes

bol.contentSubtitle: (Bol's product-content requirements -- category, e.g. GPC Code, is set above)
bol.eanHint: Required by Bol -- pushed as this offer's EAN unless overridden below.
bol.gpcHint: Only required if this EAN doesn't already exist in Bol's catalog.
bol.hazardHint: Bol allows multiple H-statements per product; only one can be saved here today.
bol.precautionHint: Bol allows multiple P-statements per product; only one can be saved here today.
bol.titleOverrideHint: Bol-only -- overrides the title synced to Bol without changing the product's real name. Every other channel keeps syncing the actual name.

pricing.title: Bol price
pricing.priceHint: Empty: automatic, so each sale earns you the shop price after VAT, Bol’s fee (incl. VAT) and shipping. Rounded up to .49 or .99.
pricing.feePercentHint: Empty: Bol’s live fee for this product and price.
pricing.basis: Shop price {{price}} · VAT {{vat}}% · Shipping per parcel {{shipping}} (set on the Bol connection)
pricing.bulkHint: Customers who buy more pay less per unit. One parcel carries them all, so the shared shipping pays for the discount.
pricing.levelsHint: Empty price: automatic. Each level must be at least 5% cheaper than the one before.

lowStock.help: Shows the product under Inventory → Low stock when its stock is above 0 and at or below this. Empty uses the shop's setting (Settings → Inventory).
lowStock.saveFailed: Failed to save the low stock alert
lowStock.title: Low stock alert

split.title: Split into packages
split.intro: Weigh each package and add it here, e.g. 10 × 380g. Each weight becomes its own sellable variant ("~380g"), priced from the price per kilo and barcoded like your scale. A weight you packed before is restocked.
split.noStock: No stock in this weight pool yet. Receive it first, then split it.
split.overLot: That's more than this lot has left.
split.prefixPlaceholder: Defaults to this SKU's own code
split.linkIntro: These variants already carry this pool's scale label. Linking makes them its packages: "Split into packages" will restock them instead of creating duplicates. Their Woo listings and barcodes stay.

casePack.description: If a supplier sells this as a sealed case/box of another product in your catalog, link it here — lets you split case stock into unit stock later.
casePack.link: This is a case of another product
casePack.title: Case pack

changeHistory.description: Name and status changes -- an immutable audit trail.
changeHistory.title: Change history

details.name: Name
details.slugHint: Lowercase letters, numbers, and single dashes only
details.tagsHint: Press Enter or comma to add. Used by Sales Channels' "by tag" enrollment rule.
details.title: General

errors.chooseMergeTarget: choose the product to merge into

header.mergeHint: This is a duplicate of a product that already exists: move everything into that one and delete this
header.resyncHint: Force-push this product's current fields and stock to every linked channel, even if nothing changed

insight.description: Cost price is recomputed daily from purchase order receiving history; not a live figure.
insight.manualSet: Cost price set manually ({{currency}} {{amount}}) -- the daily job won't overwrite it.
insight.noCost: No cost price yet — this SKU hasn't been received against a purchase order, or the daily cost-price job hasn't run since.
insight.title: Cost & margin insight

list.cantDeleteMessage: {{reason}} Archive it instead? It keeps its history and can be made active again later.
list.deleteMessage: Its variants and SKUs are deleted too.

media.saveFirst: Save the product first, then add images.
media.saveProductFirst: Save the product before uploading images
media.title: Media

merge.confirmMessage: "{{duplicate}}" will be deleted. This can't be undone.
merge.intro: For a product booked in as new when it already existed. Its stock, batches, cost, orders, purchase and receiving history, barcodes and images move to the product you pick, which keeps its own name, description, category and prices. “{{name}}” is then deleted. This can't be undone.
merge.matchAll: Match every SKU of this product to continue.
merge.title: Merge “{{name}}” into another product

pool.description: Book a bulk lot once (e.g. 20kg), then peel off individually-weighed sellable items from it over time as they're packaged.
pool.linkPool: This is portioned from a weight pool
pool.title: Weight pool

priceHistory.description: An immutable record of every effective price change -- not the same as the daily-computed cost price above.
priceHistory.title: Price history

scale.codeHint: The full code programmed into the scale for this product, including its prefix (e.g. 2900633) — type it exactly as shown on the scale, leave blank if it has a normal fixed barcode.
scale.codePlaceholder: Not sold via a scale barcode
scale.description: For a butcher/deli scale that prints a barcode with the package's weight baked in — every package gets a different full barcode, so scanning it is matched by this scale code instead.
scale.fixed: Fixed — same price per package (or a normal per-unit product)
scale.needCode: Set a scale code above too — per-kilo pricing only applies once a package's weight can actually be scanned.
scale.perWeight: Per kilo — price = rate × scanned weight
scale.title: Weight-embedded barcode

sku.barcodeScaleHint: Not used for this SKU — its real printed barcode changes per package (weight baked in).
sku.barcodeScaleUsed: Not used — see Weight-embedded barcode below

variantsCard.wooVariationsHint: On: one Woo product with a variation per variant. Off (default): each variant becomes its own separate Woo product. Changing this after the product is already synced deletes the old WooCommerce listing(s) and recreates them in the new shape.
